A Lazy Sunday Frittata

I never measure this one, but if you must: whisk up six eggs with a splash of cream and a good pinch of salt. Melt a knob of butter in an oven-safe pan, pour in the eggs, scatter over whatever cheese and vegetables you have, and slide it under the broiler until the top is just set. It is the most forgiving thing in the world and I make it whenever the fridge is looking bare.

Serve with toast and coffee and a slow morning.
